subject: CLAIM + FINDING api-surface-sonnet: resource options - EVERY buffer/texture with a CPU-cache or hazard-tracking bit is nil today
body:
Host probe (2D BGRA8 16x16, buffer 256 B) against the current tree: newBufferWithLength:options: succeeds ONLY for options==0 (so MTLResourceStorageModePrivate 0x20, WriteCombined 0x1, HazardTrackingModeUntracked 0x100 / Tracked 0x200 all return nil); newTextureWithDescriptor: succeeds for 0, 0x20 (private), 0x30 (memoryless) but returns nil for any cache/hazard bit (0x1, 0x100, 0x200, 0x21, 0x120, 0x220). Untracked hazard mode is the DEFAULT for heaps/MPS and WriteCombined is in nearly every engine's dynamic buffers, so real clients get nil. Our execution is strictly in-order per queue and memory is one coherent shared pool, so these bits change nothing observable; they must be accepted (managed 0x10 and invalid values stay nil).
CLAIM, exact regions:
compute_frontend.m: -newBufferWithLength:options: first line ('if(!length||options)return 0;' -> tegu_buffer_options_ok(options), new static helper next to it) + 'b->bufferResourceOptions=options;' after allocation; -newBufferWithBytes:length:options: rejects private/memoryless storage (Metal asserts there; nil is the safe answer).
render_encoder.inc: -[TeguComputeDevice newTextureWithDescriptor:] FIRST lines: if the descriptor has cache/hazard bits (options & ~0xf0) and they are valid (cache<=1, hazard<=2) rebuild it as TeguInternalTextureDescriptor with options&0xf0 (the same device the XR path at the top already uses), recurse, then restore t->textureResourceOptions to the app's value; -[TeguTexture cpuCacheMode] returns options&15 (was hard 0). Invalid combos stay nil. No other lines of the texture allocator are touched.
heap_frontend.inc: newHeapWithDescriptor accepts cpu<=1 and hazard<=2 (was ==0 each; size/type/storage rules unchanged); heap buffer/texture creation compare storage+cache only (hazard may differ per resource, as in Metal); tegu_heap_buffer_size accepts the valid option set; heap_frontend_host_test.inc lines 47-48 (heap with WC / untracked expected nil) flip to expected-success - semantics now supported, not a weaker test.
Tests in api_surface_host_test.inc (option matrix for buffers/textures/heaps, CPU round trip, draw).
